sections.title: Compose landing pages with focused, reusable sections.
sections.body: Davvag CMS v7 keeps the page model simple: sections, themes, assets, and dock-ready app routes.

sections.title: What is included
sections.body: Use the settings app to change branding, colors, navigation, footer links, pages, and uploaded media.

items.title: Page sections
items.body: Hero, text, split, features, CTA, and HTML sections render without a heavy CMS framework.

items.title: Theme control
items.body: Create multiple named palettes and let visitors switch between them from the dock.

items.title: Dock routing
items.body: Launch other Davvag apps inside the same clean shell using app routes.
